jobs.title: Cloud Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
Board is the most trusted Agentic Planning Platform, combining business context, Continuous Planning, and efficient enterprise AI to deliver confident, aligned, and faster decisions. Board connects enterprise data and external signals with planning models, domain expertise, and scenario modeling, enabling governed AI to understand, reason, recommend, and support action.

What’s been key to our success? Our people—we value everyone’s unique perspective and energy they bring to the organization. We collaborate openly across teams and borders. We embrace a growth mindset to get results. And we celebrate shared success as goals and milestones are achieved.

Ready to join a team where innovation meets collaboration? If you're driven by bold ideas and a customer-centric mentality, your next adventure starts here!

We are currently looking for a

## Cloud Operations Specialist

to join our R&D Department in our Chiasso HQ. Reporting to the Cloud Operation Lead, in this position you will work alongside qualified, senior Cloud professionals to ensure reliability, availability and security of our Board platform. Handling support requests from all over the world, you will have the chance to gain hands-on experience on Azure Cloud and learn in an international environment the best practices to deliver excellence to our customers.

This role requires participation in a rotating shift and on-call schedule: one week every six weeks on the evening shift (3:00 PM to 12:00 AM CET), and one week every twelve weeks on call (12:00 AM to 9:00 AM CET).

## Key responsibilities:

- Become acquainted with the distinct features of Board platform and its deployment in the Azure Cloud environment
- Coordinate an effective troubleshooting process to identify and resolve Cloud issues
- Oversee support requests and needs of our worldwide customers
- Ensure excellence in delivering services to our customers through timely feedback and follow-ups
- Provide help and assistance to your fellow team members to troubleshoot and fix errors

## Skills and Qualifications:

- Educational background in Computer Science, Computer Engineer or similar fields
- Previous exposure to any Cloud provider will be considered a plus
- Familiarity with Microsoft systems (Windows servers) is preferable
- Proactive, detail-oriented approach
- Teamworking attitude
- Good organizational skills to meet target dates
- Fluency in English

## Annual gross salary:

- CHF 53,000 plus applicable shift/on-call allowances in line with company policy.

## Our commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

Join a company that believes in the added value of diversity, inclusion, and belonging. We foster a working environment in which all people are respected and valued, for all aspects which make them unique. We hire you for who you are, and we want you to bring your true self to work every day!

Board International is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce.

Your personal data will be stored for as long as it is necessary to process the job applications that you submitted and for the provision of the service that you requested. Your personal data may also be processed for the fulfillment of the obligations provided for by law. Your data will in any case be deleted without unjustified delay once the aforementioned legal obligations have been fulfilled. Your personal data are collected and used by Board International SA and/or its subsidiaries that are located in the EU or outside on the basis of the appropriate safeguards provided by the European Regulation 2016/679. At any time you may request to access, to correct and/or delete your personal data used by Board International SA or by its subsidiaries for recruiting purposes.

For further question, please refer to our Privacy Policy at https://www.board.com/en/privacy-policy

descriptionByLocale.it:
Board è la piattaforma di pianificazione agente più affidabile, combinando il contesto aziendale, Pianificazione continua e AI aziendale efficiente per fornire decisioni sicure, allineate e più veloci. Board collega i dati aziendali e i segnali esterni con modelli di pianificazione, competenze di dominio e modelli di scenario, consentendo AI governato per comprendere, ragionare, consigliare e sostenere l'azione.

Qual è la chiave del nostro successo? Il nostro popolo – apprezziamo la prospettiva e l’energia unica di tutti che portano all’organizzazione. Collaboriamo apertamente attraverso squadre e confini. Abbracciamo una mentalità di crescita per ottenere risultati. E celebriamo il successo condiviso come obiettivi e pietre miliari sono raggiunti.

Pronto ad unirsi a un team in cui l'innovazione incontra la collaborazione? Se sei guidato da idee audaci e da una mentalità orientata al cliente, la tua prossima avventura inizia qui!

Stiamo cercando un

## Specialista delle operazioni cloud

per unirsi al nostro dipartimento R&D nel nostro quartier generale di Chiasso. Segnalando al Cloud Operation Lead, in questa posizione lavorerai insieme a professionisti qualificati e senior Cloud per garantire affidabilità, disponibilità e sicurezza della nostra piattaforma Board. Gestire richieste di supporto da tutto il mondo, si avrà la possibilità di acquisire esperienza pratica su Azure Cloud e imparare in un ambiente internazionale le migliori pratiche per fornire eccellenza ai nostri clienti.

Questo ruolo richiede la partecipazione a un turno di rotazione e il calendario di chiamata: una settimana ogni sei settimane il turno di sera (3:00 PM a 12:00 AM CET), e una settimana ogni dodici settimane in chiamata (12:00 AM a 9:00 AM CET).

## Responsabilità chiave:

- Fatti conoscere le caratteristiche distintive della piattaforma Board e la sua distribuzione nell'ambiente Azure Cloud
- Coordinare un processo efficace di risoluzione dei problemi per identificare e risolvere i problemi Cloud
- Superare le richieste di supporto e le esigenze dei nostri clienti in tutto il mondo
- Garantire l'eccellenza nel fornire servizi ai nostri clienti attraverso feedback tempestivi e follow-up
- Fornire assistenza e assistenza ai membri del tuo team per risolvere problemi e correggere errori

## Competenze e qualifiche:

- Sfondo educativo in Informatica, Ingegnere Informatico o campi simili
- L'esposizione precedente a qualsiasi provider Cloud sarà considerata un plus
- La familiarità con i sistemi Microsoft (server Windows) è preferibile
- Approccio proattivo e dettagliato
- Atteggiamento del lavoro di squadra
- Buone capacità organizzative per soddisfare le date di destinazione
- Fluency in inglese

## stipendio lordo annuale:

- CHF 53.000 più le indennità per turni/in-call applicabili in linea con la politica aziendale.

## Il nostro impegno per la diversità e l'inclusione

Unisciti a una società che crede nel valore aggiunto della diversità, inclusione e appartenenza. Promuoviamo un ambiente di lavoro in cui tutte le persone sono rispettate e valutate, per tutti gli aspetti che li rendono unici. Ti assumiamo per chi sei, e vogliamo che porti il tuo vero sé a lavorare ogni giorno!

Board International è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità e si impegna a una forza lavoro diversificata e inclusiva.

I tuoi dati personali saranno conservati per tutto il tempo necessario per elaborare le domande di lavoro che hai presentato e per la fornitura del servizio richiesto. I Suoi dati personali possono anche essere trattati per l'adempimento degli obblighi previsti dalla legge. I tuoi dati verranno comunque cancellati senza ingiustificato ritardo una volta che i suddetti obblighi legali sono stati adempiuti. I Suoi dati personali sono raccolti e utilizzati da Board International SA e/o dalle sue controllate che si trovano nell'UE o al di fuori in base alle opportune garanzie previste dal Regolamento Europeo 2016/679. In qualsiasi momento potrà richiedere l'accesso, la rettifica e/o l'eliminazione dei suoi dati personali utilizzati da Board International SA o dalle sue controllate per scopi di reclutamento.

Per ulteriori domande, consultare la nostra Informativa sulla privacy all'indirizzo https://www.board.com/en/privacy-policy

descriptionByLocale.de:
Board ist die vertrauenswürdigste Agentenplanungsplattform, die Geschäftskontext, kontinuierliche Planung und effiziente Unternehmens-KI kombiniert, um selbstbewusste, abgestimmte und schnellere Entscheidungen zu treffen. Board verbindet Unternehmensdaten und externe Signale mit Planungsmodellen, Domänenexpertise und Szenariomodellierung, so dass verwaltete KI Maßnahmen verstehen, begründen, empfehlen und unterstützen kann.

Was war der Schlüssel zu unserem Erfolg? Unsere Mitarbeiter - wir schätzen die einzigartige Perspektive und Energie, die jeder in die Organisation bringt. Wir arbeiten offen über Teams und Grenzen hinweg zusammen. Wir nehmen eine Wachstumsmentalität an, um Ergebnisse zu erzielen. Und wir feiern den gemeinsamen Erfolg, wenn Ziele und Meilensteine erreicht werden.

Bereit, einem Team beizutreten, in dem Innovation auf Zusammenarbeit trifft? Wenn Sie von mutigen Ideen und einer kundenorientierten Mentalität angetrieben werden, beginnt Ihr nächstes Abenteuer hier!

Wir suchen derzeit eine

## Cloud Operations Spezialist

um unserer F & E-Abteilung in unserem Chiasso-Hauptquartier beizutreten. In dieser Position arbeiten Sie mit qualifizierten, erfahrenen Cloud-Experten zusammen, um die Zuverlässigkeit, Verfügbarkeit und Sicherheit unserer Board-Plattform zu gewährleisten. Durch die Bearbeitung von Supportanfragen aus der ganzen Welt haben Sie die Möglichkeit, praktische Erfahrungen mit Azure Cloud zu sammeln und in einem internationalen Umfeld die besten Praktiken zu erlernen, um unseren Kunden Exzellenz zu bieten.

Diese Rolle erfordert die Teilnahme an einem rotierenden Schicht- und Bereitschaftsplan: eine Woche alle sechs Wochen in der Abendschicht (3:00 Uhr bis 12:00 Uhr MEZ) und eine Woche alle zwölf Wochen im Bereitschaftsdienst (12:00 Uhr bis 9:00 Uhr MEZ).

## Hauptzuständigkeiten:

- Machen Sie sich mit den Besonderheiten der Board-Plattform und ihrer Bereitstellung in der Azure Cloud-Umgebung vertraut
- Koordinieren Sie einen effektiven Fehlerbehebungsprozess, um Cloud-Probleme zu identifizieren und zu lösen
- Überwachen Sie Supportanfragen und -bedürfnisse unserer weltweiten Kunden
- Gewährleistung einer hervorragenden Erbringung von Dienstleistungen für unsere Kunden durch zeitnahes Feedback und Follow-ups
- Geben Sie Ihren Teammitgliedern Hilfe und Unterstützung, um Fehler zu beheben und zu beheben

## Fähigkeiten und Qualifikationen:

- Bildungshintergrund in Informatik, Computer Engineer oder ähnlichen Bereichen
- Frühere Exposition gegenüber einem Cloud-Anbieter wird als Plus angesehen
- Vertrautheit mit Microsoft-Systemen (Windows-Server) ist vorzuziehen
- Proaktiver, detailorientierter Ansatz
- Teaming Einstellung
- Gute organisatorische Fähigkeiten, um Zieltermine zu erfüllen
- Fluency in Englisch

## Jahresbruttogehalt:

- CHF 53.000 plus anwendbare Schicht-/Abrufzulagen im Einklang mit der Firmenpolitik.

## Unser Engagement für Vielfalt und Inklusion

Treten Sie einem Unternehmen bei, das an den Mehrwert von Vielfalt, Inklusion und Zugehörigkeit glaubt. Wir fördern ein Arbeitsumfeld, in dem alle Menschen respektiert und geschätzt werden, für alle Aspekte, die sie einzigartig machen. Wir stellen Sie ein, wer Sie sind, und wir möchten, dass Sie Ihr wahres Selbst jeden Tag zur Arbeit bringen!

Board International ist ein Arbeitgeber für Chancengleichheit und engagiert sich für eine vielfältige und integrative Belegschaft.

Ihre personenbezogenen Daten werden so lange gespeichert, wie es für die Bearbeitung der von Ihnen eingereichten Bewerbungen und für die Erbringung der von Ihnen angeforderten Dienstleistung erforderlich ist. Ihre personenbezogenen Daten können auch zur Erfüllung der gesetzlich vorgesehenen Verpflichtungen verarbeitet werden. Ihre Daten werden in jedem Fall ohne ungerechtfertigte Verzögerung gelöscht, sobald die oben genannten gesetzlichen Verpflichtungen erfüllt sind. Ihre personenbezogenen Daten werden von Board International SA und/oder ihren Tochtergesellschaften, die sich in der EU oder außerhalb befinden, auf der Grundlage der entsprechenden Sicherheitsvorkehrungen der Europäischen Verordnung 2016/679 erhoben und verwendet. Sie können jederzeit den Zugriff, die Berichtigung und/oder Löschung Ihrer personenbezogenen Daten verlangen, die von Board International SA oder ihren Tochtergesellschaften für Rekrutierungszwecke verwendet werden.

Für weitere Fragen lesen Sie bitte unsere Datenschutzerklärung unter https://www.board.com/en/privacy-policy
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Le conseil d'administration est la plate-forme de planification Agentique la plus fiable, combinant le contexte d'affaires, la planification continue et l'IA d'entreprise efficace pour livrer des décisions confiantes, alignées et plus rapides. Le conseil d'administration relie les données d'entreprise et les signaux externes aux modèles de planification, à l'expertise du domaine et à la modélisation de scénarios, ce qui permet à l'IA régie de comprendre, de raisonner, de recommander et d'appuyer l'action.

Quelles ont été les clés de notre succès? Notre personnel, nous valorisons tout le monde dans une perspective et une énergie uniques qu'il apporte à l'organisation. Nous collaborons ouvertement entre les équipes et les frontières. Nous acceptons un état d'esprit de croissance pour obtenir des résultats. Et nous célébrons le succès commun à mesure que les objectifs et les jalons sont atteints.

Prêt à rejoindre une équipe où l'innovation rencontre la collaboration? Si vous êtes animé par des idées audacieuses et une mentalité centrée sur le client, votre prochaine aventure commence ici !

Nous sommes actuellement à la recherche

## Spécialiste des opérations en nuage

pour rejoindre notre département de R-D à notre QG de Chiasso. Dans ce poste, vous travaillerez aux côtés de professionnels Cloud seniors qualifiés pour assurer la fiabilité, la disponibilité et la sécurité de notre plateforme Board. Traitement des demandes de support du monde entier, vous aurez la chance d'acquérir une expérience pratique sur Azure Cloud et d'apprendre dans un environnement international les meilleures pratiques pour offrir l'excellence à nos clients.

Ce rôle exige la participation à un poste tournant et à un horaire de garde : une semaine toutes les six semaines pendant le quart du soir (15 h 00 à 12 h 00 CET) et une semaine toutes les douze semaines pendant le quart du soir (12 h 00 à 9 h CET).

## Principales responsabilités :

- Découvrez les caractéristiques distinctes de la plateforme Board et son déploiement dans l'environnement Azure Cloud
- Coordonner un processus efficace de dépannage pour identifier et résoudre les problèmes de Cloud
- Surveiller les demandes d'assistance et les besoins de nos clients du monde entier
- Assurer l'excellence dans la prestation de services à nos clients par la rétroaction et le suivi en temps opportun
- Fournir de l'aide et de l'aide aux membres de votre équipe pour résoudre les problèmes et corriger les erreurs

## Compétences et qualifications :

- Études en informatique, en informatique ou dans des domaines similaires
- Une exposition antérieure à tout fournisseur de Cloud sera considérée comme un plus
- Familiarité avec les systèmes Microsoft (serveurs Windows) est préférable
- Approche proactive axée sur les détails
- attitude de travail d'équipe
- Bonnes compétences organisationnelles pour atteindre les dates cibles
- Connaissance de l'anglais

## Salaire annuel brut:

- CHF 53 000 plus les indemnités de poste/sur appel applicables conformément à la politique de l'entreprise.

## Notre engagement envers la diversité et l'inclusion

Rejoignez une entreprise qui croit en la valeur ajoutée de la diversité, de l'inclusion et de l'appartenance. Nous favorisons un environnement de travail dans lequel toutes les personnes sont respectées et valorisées, pour tous les aspects qui les rendent uniques. Nous vous engageons pour qui vous êtes, et nous voulons que vous apportiez votre vrai moi au travail tous les jours!

Board International est un employeur sur un pied d'égalité et s'engage envers une main-d'oeuvre diversifiée et inclusive.

Vos données personnelles seront stockées aussi longtemps qu'il sera nécessaire de traiter les demandes d'emploi que vous avez soumises et pour la fourniture du service que vous avez demandé. Vos données personnelles peuvent également être traitées pour remplir les obligations prévues par la loi. Vos données seront en tout cas supprimées sans délai injustifié une fois que les obligations légales susmentionnées auront été remplies. Vos données personnelles sont collectées et utilisées par Board International SA et/ou ses filiales situées dans l'UE ou à l'extérieur sur la base des garanties appropriées prévues par le règlement européen 2016/679. À tout moment, vous pouvez demander à accéder, corriger et/ou supprimer vos données personnelles utilisées par Board International SA ou par ses filiales à des fins de recrutement.

Pour toute question complémentaire, veuillez consulter notre politique de confidentialité à l'adresse https://www.board.com/fr/privacy-policy

jobs.title: Solution Developer
jobs.description:
Board is the most trusted Agentic Planning Platform, combining business context, Continuous Planning, and efficient enterprise AI to deliver confident, aligned, and faster decisions. Board connects enterprise data and external signals with planning models, domain expertise, and scenario modeling, enabling governed AI to understand, reason, recommend, and support action. What’s been key to our success? Our people—we value everyone’s unique perspective and energy they bring to the organization. We collaborate openly across teams and borders. We embrace a growth mindset to get results. And we celebrate shared success as goals and milestones are achieved. Ready to join a team where innovation meets collaboration? If you're driven by bold ideas and a customer-centric mentality, your next adventure starts here!

We are seeking a  Solution Developer to build either retail, FP&A, and supply chain planning applications supporting planning decisions.

You will work closely with Product Owners to translate requirements into reusable solution components that ensure a robust technical framework as well as immediate business impact.

Key Responsibilities

- Develop end-to-end solutions for buyers, suppliers, financial planners and merchandisers

- Translate retail processes into system logic

- Support testing, validation, and audit-ready outputs

- Contribute to documentation, demos, and solution assets

- Collaborate with Product Owners to refine backlog and priorities

Required Skills

- 2–4+ years in retail planning, supply chain planning, financial planning or solution development

- Familiarity with merchandising processes

- Experience with planning platforms

## Why Join Us

This role gives you the opportunity to shape how organizations plan and operate. Be part of a high-impact team that delivers market-ready, industry-leading solutions using Board’s intelligent planning platform.

Board International is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce.

Your personal data will be stored for as long as it is necessary to process the job applications that you submitted and for the provision of the service that you requested. Your personal data may also be processed for the fulfillment of the obligations provided for by law. Your data will in any case be deleted without unjustified delay once the aforementioned legal obligations have been fulfilled. Your personal data are collected and used by Board International SA and/or its subsidiaries that are located in the EU or outside on the basis of the appropriate safeguards provided by the European Regulation 2016/679. At any time you may request to access, to correct and/or delete your personal data used by Board International SA or by its subsidiaries for recruiting purposes.

For further question, please refer to our Privacy Policy at https://www.board.com/en/privacy-policy

jobs.title: UX Designer
jobs.description:
Board is the most trusted Agentic Planning Platform, combining business context, Continuous Planning, and efficient enterprise AI to deliver confident, aligned, and faster decisions.

Board connects enterprise data and external signals with planning models, domain expertise, and scenario modeling, enabling governed AI to understand, reason, recommend, and support action.

What’s been key to our success? Our people—we value everyone’s unique perspective and energy they bring to the organization. We collaborate openly across teams and borders. We embrace a growth mindset to get results. And we celebrate shared success as goals and milestones are achieved.

Ready to join a team where innovation meets collaboration? If you're driven by bold ideas and a customer-centric mentality, your next adventure starts here!

We are looking for a passionate and innovative

## User Experience Designer (UX Designer)

to join our dynamic UX team. Reporting to the Head of UX Design, you will have the opportunity to influence the product direction and drive innovation through your expertise in user-centered design.

In this role, you will collaborate closely with Product Managers, Product Owners, Developers, and fellow designers to define and help implement clear, effective, and user-centered experiences for our enterprise software.

## Your responsibilities will include:

- Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to understand the solution/product goals and design requirements.
- Translate user needs, business objectives, and technical requirements into clear, intuitive, and effective design solutions.
- Rapidly create and iterate designs using conceptual diagrams, wireframes, and interactive prototypes while ensuring the delivery of clear, detailed design specifications.
- Apply design solutions directly within the Board platform, using its built-in design capabilities to create usable interfaces, data-rich views, and business-oriented workflows while adapting to platform constraints.
- Leverage our pattern library to create designs and identify opportunities to expand it by working closely with the UI infrastructure team.
- Communicate conceptual ideas, design rationale, and user-centered design processes effectively.
- Contribute to evolving design standards and guidelines to enhance overall user experience quality across all of Board's solutions/products.
- Apply usability heuristics and stay current with design best practices to evaluate new and existing features, offering valuable suggestions for improvement.

## What we look for:

- Academic background in Design, Human-Computer Interaction, or a related field.
- Proven experience in UX design, with a strong portfolio showcasing your work. Experience with enterprise software is a plus.
- Good knowledge of user-centered and iterative design processes, usability principles, and best practices.
- Proficiency in Figma is required; experience with other design tools is welcome.
- Familiarity with AI-assisted design workflows, prototyping, and design-to-code collaboration, including experience with tools such as Figma Make, Cursor, or similar platforms, is also valued.
- Basic understanding of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript is a plus and can support effective collaboration with engineering teams.
- Knowledge of accessibility standards (e.g., WCAG) is a plus.
- Strong organizational, analytical, and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams effectively.
- Strong collaboration skills and experience working with cross-functional teams, including Product Managers, Product Owners, and Engineers.
- Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate design rationale clearly to different stakeholders.
- Experience or domain knowledge in enterprise planning processes such as supply chain, forecasting, assortment and replenishment in retail, and financial planning is considered an advantage.
- Self-motivated, with the ability to work in a fast-paced, agile environment.
- Fluency in English; additional languages are advantageous.

## Our commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

Join a company that believes in the added value of diversity, inclusion, and belonging. We foster a working environment in which all people are respected and valued, for all aspects which make them unique. We hire you for who you are, and we want you to bring your true self to work every day!

descriptionByLocale.en:
Board is the most trusted Agentic Planning Platform, combining business context, Continuous Planning, and efficient enterprise AI to deliver confident, aligned, and faster decisions.

Board connects enterprise data and external signals with planning models, domain expertise, and scenario modeling, enabling governed AI to understand, reason, recommend, and support action.

What’s been key to our success? Our people—we value everyone’s unique perspective and energy they bring to the organization. We collaborate openly across teams and borders. We embrace a growth mindset to get results. And we celebrate shared success as goals and milestones are achieved.

Ready to join a team where innovation meets collaboration? If you're driven by bold ideas and a customer-centric mentality, your next adventure starts here!

We are looking for a passionate and innovative

## User Experience Designer (UX Designer)

to join our dynamic UX team. Reporting to the Head of UX Design, you will have the opportunity to influence the product direction and drive innovation through your expertise in user-centered design.

In this role, you will collaborate closely with Product Managers, Product Owners, Developers, and fellow designers to define and help implement clear, effective, and user-centered experiences for our enterprise software.

## Your responsibilities will include:

- Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to understand the solution/product goals and design requirements.
- Translate user needs, business objectives, and technical requirements into clear, intuitive, and effective design solutions.
- Rapidly create and iterate designs using conceptual diagrams, wireframes, and interactive prototypes while ensuring the delivery of clear, detailed design specifications.
- Apply design solutions directly within the Board platform, using its built-in design capabilities to create usable interfaces, data-rich views, and business-oriented workflows while adapting to platform constraints.
- Leverage our pattern library to create designs and identify opportunities to expand it by working closely with the UI infrastructure team.
- Communicate conceptual ideas, design rationale, and user-centered design processes effectively.
- Contribute to evolving design standards and guidelines to enhance overall user experience quality across all of Board's solutions/products.
- Apply usability heuristics and stay current with design best practices to evaluate new and existing features, offering valuable suggestions for improvement.

## What we look for:

- Academic background in Design, Human-Computer Interaction, or a related field.
- Proven experience in UX design, with a strong portfolio showcasing your work. Experience with enterprise software is a plus.
- Good knowledge of user-centered and iterative design processes, usability principles, and best practices.
- Proficiency in Figma is required; experience with other design tools is welcome.
- Familiarity with AI-assisted design workflows, prototyping, and design-to-code collaboration, including experience with tools such as Figma Make, Cursor, or similar platforms, is also valued.
- Basic understanding of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript is a plus and can support effective collaboration with engineering teams.
- Knowledge of accessibility standards (e.g., WCAG) is a plus.
- Strong organizational, analytical, and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams effectively.
- Strong collaboration skills and experience working with cross-functional teams, including Product Managers, Product Owners, and Engineers.
- Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate design rationale clearly to different stakeholders.
- Experience or domain knowledge in enterprise planning processes such as supply chain, forecasting, assortment and replenishment in retail, and financial planning is considered an advantage.
- Self-motivated, with the ability to work in a fast-paced, agile environment.
- Fluency in English; additional languages are advantageous.

## Our commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

Join a company that believes in the added value of diversity, inclusion, and belonging. We foster a working environment in which all people are respected and valued, for all aspects which make them unique. We hire you for who you are, and we want you to bring your true self to work every day!

Board International is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce.

Your personal data will be stored for as long as it is necessary to process the job applications that you submitted and for the provision of the service that you requested. Your personal data may also be processed for the fulfillment of the obligations provided for by law. Your data will in any case be deleted without unjustified delay once the aforementioned legal obligations have been fulfilled. Your personal data are collected and used by Board International SA and/or its subsidiaries that are located in the EU or outside on the basis of the appropriate safeguards provided by the European Regulation 2016/679. At any time you may request to access, to correct and/or delete your personal data used by Board International SA or by its subsidiaries for recruiting purposes.

For further question, please refer to our Privacy Policy at https://www.board.com/en/privacy-policy
